title: Scalability
subtitle: Scaling out buys capacity until the serial work says stop
motto: Adding servers is not the same as adding capacity
keyInsight: The work that cannot be split sets a ceiling on scaling out, so the number to watch is the serial fraction, not the server count.

decisions.title: Model the serial fraction, not just server count
decisions.description: Capacity grows by the Amdahl speedup, so the sim shows diminishing returns and a ceiling instead of a straight line.
decisions.alternatives: Linear scaling is simpler but teaches the wrong lesson: that capacity is servers times one server.

decisions.title: Price scale-up higher per unit of capacity
decisions.description: A bigger machine costs 1.5 times more per unit, so the trade-off has a real price as well as a ceiling and a larger blast radius.
decisions.alternatives: Equal pricing would make scale-up look strictly cheaper, hiding why fleets of small machines exist.
